metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0001 records sharpe below that threshold.
D2-006 requires DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count; OL-0001 records dsr below that threshold.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0001 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL; OL-0001 records cost_drag_fraction above that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0001 records walk_forward_efficiency below that threshold.
